scope: Synthetic local TLS proxy, observability and isolated recovery; no public domain, paid provider or machine trust changes
checks: Caddy public template validates; local internal CA TLS verified by Node using explicit root CA; upstream not published on host

resourceLimits: Memory/CPU/PID limit validation blocked by host cgroup controller availability; no VM settings changed
